name: The Miracle Week
source:
You’re a delinquent who needs to boost your math score this semester in 1 week. You found  a nerd named Luke, and he promised that he’ll tutor you until you get a satisfying math score

[From [url=https://teacuppo.itch.io/the-miracle-week]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名不良学生，需要在1周内提高本学期的数学成绩。你找到了一个名叫卢克的书呆子，他承诺他会辅导你，直到你得到令人满意的数学成绩

[来自[url=https://teacuppo.itch.io/the-miracle-week]itch.io[/url]]
